## Change and evidence

Describe the concrete behavior or research finding changed, scope, source locators, and record/version IDs.

## Instructions and continuity

- [ ] I read AGENTS.md and docs/PROJECT-RULES.md.
- [ ] For research work, I followed docs/RESEARCH-INGEST.md and recorded the applicable plan/schema/readiness, receipt, merge and repeat-import checks.
- [ ] New or changed requirements are recorded in the relevant contract and docs/RULE-CHANGELOG.md, or this PR introduces none.
- [ ] Accepted identities, source locators, corrections, quarantine and reviewed work are preserved; changed evidence reopens dependent acceptance.
- [ ] The handoff records completed work, unresolved gaps and the next action; statuses distinguish technical, scientific and release checks.

## Validation

List commands/results and rendered/source checks for the exact version. Record anything not run. Include `node scripts/check-governance.mjs`.
